scope: Correctness and ownership cleanup of queued gRPC response callbacks, not a timing benchmark or C/Rust comparison. Nine methods repeated eight times, with 72 calls over one connection per measured sample. Native ARC/tracing at O0/O2 on six operating-system/architecture combinations.
comparisons: Exact output against the checked-in expected file, local and remote raw interpretation, native client/interpreted server, interpreted client/native server and native client/native server. The raw interpreter disables compiler optimization. Both memory modes execute the same source and inputs.
flags: fwp build --gc arc|tracing --service queued --emit-c tests/grpc/queued-client.fwp -O1, then compile generated client/server C with -O0 or -O2, -std=gnu11 -ffp-contract=off -w and the compiler runtime/link options. GCC adds -flto=auto -flto-partition=balanced when C exceeds 1,000,000 bytes and optimization is not O0. No timing comparison is made between these compiler configurations. Exact compiler versions and generated-C hashes are recorded per platform.
ordinary_server: ARC: FWP_GC_STRESS=0, FWP_GC_VERIFY=0, FWP_REUSE_VERIFY=0. Tracing: all three are 1. FWP_GC is removed from the child environment.
measured_server: FWP_SERVER_MEASURE_CALLS=72, FWP_GC=off, FWP_FREE=1, FWP_GC_STRESS=0, FWP_GC_VERIFY=0, FWP_REUSE_VERIFY=0, FWP_GC_STATS=0. Counters cover managed server allocations/retains after listener readiness, not just closures. Requested bytes and allocator charges are separate. Final charge is measured after all calls and connection finalization.
memory_limits: The listener remains live. Its exact socket-wait allocations are identified by pointer/owner and charged separately; no guessed allowance. Non-listener final charge, response owners and child tasks must be zero. Excludes OS buffers, external allocations, allocator metadata, stack pools, total-process memory and allocations before readiness. Does not test orderly listener shutdown.
negative_control: An ARC build intentionally omits queued-value release. At both O0 and O2 on every host, more than eight live response channels must exit 201. Tracing controls retain marking; all ARC executables exclude scan/mark/sweep routines.
binary_inspection: 84 actual ELF, Mach-O or PE executables match their native hosts. Saved generated C, disassembly and symbol tables were inspected; hashes identify original complete files. Four cleanup samples and two deliberate leak controls per host.
test_harness: Full REST target passes on all six native hosts, including silent-child startup deadline and reap regression. Three immutable tracing executables replace seven compilations; each test still starts its own fresh server. No elapsed-time improvement is claimed.
wasm_limits: Two WebAssembly jobs preserve existing ownership regressions. They do not execute or establish support for a gRPC server in WebAssembly.
